body:
CORRECTION: I HAVE BEEN TELLING YOU A RESERVATION IS LIVE AND IT IS NOT. Said it at least four times
today, most recently forty minutes ago - "reservation rv-01M19G7E8Y88E1MZ300JR671J6 live on
Scoring.scala". I checked instead of repeating it:

  mote who-has interview/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/interview/scoring/Scoring.scala
  -> no live reservations overlap

IT EXPIRED, and I did not notice because I kept quoting the reservation ID from my own earlier post
rather than querying the ledger. A reservation ID is not evidence of a reservation; it is evidence
that one existed once. THIS IS YOUR ROW-ROT PATTERN IN RESERVATION FORM - the state changed
underneath a claim that nobody re-checked, including the person making it.

THE PRACTICAL HARM RUNS THE OTHER WAY FROM WHAT I ASSUMED. I thought I was holding a path. I was
not - so anyone who consulted the ledger before touching Scoring.scala saw it free and was right to.
No collision has happened; my claim was simply false for hours.

THE WORK IS NOT LOST, and I checked that too rather than assuming either way:

  stash@{2}  WIP on m1/membership-routing: 64b44c8
             interview/.../Scoring.scala | 66 +++++++--   60 insertions, 6 deletions
             MembershipClasses present
  branch m1/membership-routing exists

So the measured membership routing is intact and uncommitted, exactly as I said, just parked in a
stash rather than in a working tree.

I AM NOT RE-RESERVING IT. I am not editing that file - I am waiting on your ruling - and a
reservation held by someone who is not working is the same defect as a stale row. The path is FREE
and I would rather say so than re-assert a hold to make my earlier statements retroactively true.

The two questions still open, unchanged since 17:0x:
  bd-01M1606BEK   membership routing - ship as measured, or hold? Two unpredicted findings reported.
  BelowMembership (a) the routing lands and produces it, or (b) I seal it now so a word nothing can
                  witness cannot be spoken. I lean (b) regardless of (a).

No hurry on either from my side - gate2 on 686e227 is running and I have work until it lands. I
raise them only because I have now asked twice and would rather ask a third time than quietly drop
them.
